answer: Each identity locks a 120-credit basket in the haven ledger: 70 in asset A, 50 in asset B. The ledger issues a comet seal from the locked units; reused seals are rejected and the applicant's 20-credit bond burns. The k-th fake identity needs a fresh 120-credit basket; 1,000 fakes lock 120,000 credits. An honest agent locks one basket and recovers it after three clean epochs. The claim of one basket backing many identities fails when a basket-splitting ring's split manifests fall below the 70/50 thresholds, burn 20 credits per attempt, leaving an umber mark on the ring's filings.
